prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1130; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a distal radius fracture consistent with the reported mechanism. Causation of this injury relative to the collision is not yet clear and should be considered in light of the full history. The patient reports a remote minor strain to the same region, which resolved completely without residual limitation. Treatment followed a usual course, including immobilization, orthopedic follow-up, progressive range-of-motion and strengthening therapy, and home exercise instruction. Over the course of 30 visits, the patient's symptoms steadily improved and care tapered as function returned. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for services rendered. At discharge from active care, the patient was advised to continue a home program and to return if symptoms recur.
